rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a 3BB blastocyst and correctly notes loose ICM/TE, but overstates certainty about full expansion/thinning zona and describes some features not clearly discernible from this single image.
Integrates age, BMI, ovarian reserve markers, sperm data, endometrium, diagnosis, and lifestyle with embryo quality reasonably well, though some links are speculative.

Reasoning has notable flaws: it incorrectly treats 6 MII out of 16 COCs as a fertilization rate, overinterprets paternal age/alcohol effects, and draws conclusions about diminished reserve and protocol changes without adequate support.

Some recommendations are standard (proceed with transfer, lifestyle counseling, consider sperm DNA fragmentation workup), but strong endorsement of PGT-A based mainly on paternal age/one cycle and claims about diminished reserve/aggressive stimulation are not well guideline-supported.
Provides clear next-step recommendations for transfer and future evaluation, including counseling and possible sperm testing/ICSI, though several suggestions are insufficiently nuanced.
